hook: Your feelings (感) move your heart (心): you are impressed and admire what someone did.
Dry (乾) and parched (燥): air with no water at all, like a desert.
Connected (関) and linked in a row (連): things that are related to each other.
A machine (機) acting as a gateway (関): an engine, or an organization that runs things.
Raw (生) material from the ground (地): plain cloth or dough before you make anything.
Write (記) it in (入): filling in a form.
Send (寄) and give (付) money to a cause: a donation.
Odd (奇) and mysterious (妙): something very strange and curious.
The right thing (義) as your task (務): a duty you must do.
A doubt (疑) that becomes a question (問): something you are not sure about.
Hurry (急) plus speed (速): very rapid change or progress.
Compete (競) with your skill (技): a sports match or contest.
From 切る (to cut): a knife that cuts well, or a rope that snaps and breaks.
Forbid (禁) smoke (煙): no smoking here.
Bitter suffering (苦) plus pain (痛): real agony.
Divide into areas (区) and keep separate (別): telling things apart.
Teach (訓) and drill until polished (練): training and practice.
Decide (決) in your heart (心): firm determination.
Missing (欠) from your seat (席): being absent from class.
The present (現) state (状): how things are right now.
The effect (効) gives fruit (果): the result something has.
High (高) value (価): expensive. Same sound as 効果, so watch the kanji.
School (校) plus building (舎): the school building.
The later (後) one (者): the latter of two things. Opposite of 前者.
Your country (国) on the register (籍): your nationality.
Bone (骨) plus break (折): a fractured bone.
A small (小) thing you wrap (包): a parcel in the post.
Mixed (混) and jumbled (雑): a crowded, congested place.
Mixed (混) and in disorder (乱): total chaos and confusion.
The most (最) low (低): the lowest, or simply the worst.
さけぶ sounds like 'Sake! Boo!': a drunk fan shouting loudly at the game.
Lost in a maze (迷): you are lost or cannot decide which way to go.
A thing (事) worth seeing (見): splendid, wonderful to look at.
The bright (明) day (日) after (後) tomorrow: like 明日 but one day later.
向 means direction: to turn and face that way.
Steamed (蒸し) and hot (暑い): hot, humid summer weather in Japan.
Bright (明) and certain (確): very clear and definite.
A name (名) word (詞): a noun, the word that names a thing.
A famous (名) person (人): a master or expert at something.
Things (物) and matters (事): everything in life.
やっかい sounds like 'yuck, eh?': a troublesome thing you wish you did not have.
Excellent (優) and outstanding (秀): a top student.
The feeling (情) between friends (友): friendship.
The needed (要) points (点): the main points, the gist.
The middle (中) of the world (世): society, the world we live in.
Benefit (利) plus gain (益): profit.
Under one roof (宀 on top), many students live together: a dormitory.
Outside (外) the usual example (例): an exception to the rule.
分 shows a knife cutting something in two: to divide or separate.
A section (課) with a topic (題): a task or assignment you must work on.
From 狩る (to hunt): 狩 has the dog radical, a hunter goes out with his dog.
Enjoy (享) and receive (受): to enjoy something you were given, like freedom or a right.
Warp (経) and weft (緯) threads: how events were woven together, the full story.
A person (人) from the old days (故): someone who has passed away.
Set up (設) and prepared (備): the equipment and facilities of a place.
Keep things in moderation (節) and tight (約): saving money.
善 means good: the opposite of 悪 (evil).
Specialize (専) and attack (攻) one subject: your university major.
The earlier (前) one (者): the former of two. Opposite of 後者.
Announce (宣) and spread (伝) the word: advertising and publicity.
Loss (損) plus harm (害): damage you suffer.
Stay put (滞) and be there (在): a stay somewhere, like at a hotel.
Big (大) thing: 大したもの means something great; 大したことない means no big deal.
Facing (対) an image (象): the target or object you aim at or study.
The great (大) one who controls (統) and leads (領) the nation: the president.
Replace (代) and manage (理): someone acting for you, a deputy or proxy.
互 looks like two hooks gripping each other: mutual, each other.
From 確か (certain): you check to make sure something is true.
Many (多) or few (少): some amount, a little.
From 戦う (to fight): 戦 has the 戈 halberd, a weapon for battle.
達 means reach: to reach a goal or a number.
Other (他) person (人): a stranger, someone not related to you.
A single (単) position (位): one unit, or one course credit at school.
A group (団) as one body (体): an organization.
Your place (位) on the ground (地): your status in society.
A piece of land (地) divided into wards (区): a district.
Pass through (通) and go (行): passing along a road.
通 means pass through: a road leads somewhere, or your words get through.
Pass through (通) a message or trust (信): communications.
Stick (付き) together (合い): keeping company with friends or colleagues.
付 is a hand (寸) touching a person (亻): to stick or be attached.
Make it stick (付): to attach or add something, like turning on a light.
Go out (出) and meet (会): an encounter, meeting someone new.
Suitable (適) and cut (切) just right: appropriate for the situation.
鉄 has the metal radical (金): iron, the metal trains and bridges are made of.
An iron (鉄) road (道): the railway.
A model rule (典) cast in a mould (型): a typical example.
Same (同) one (一): exactly the same thing, identical.
Same (同) kind or manner (様): just like, the same way.
Alone (独) in body (身): single, not married.
Untie (解) a knot: it comes undone, or a problem is solved.
流 means flow: to make water or tears flow away.
半 means half: halfway or the middle, like 九月半ば (mid September).
眺 has the eye (目): to look out at the view for a long time.
悩 has the heart (忄) and a brain part: your heart and head are troubled.
Resembles (似) and matches (合う): clothes that suit you.
Enter (入) the place (場): admission, like an entry ticket.
願 has the head (頁): bow your head and wish or ask, お願いします.
Farming (農) as your work (業): agriculture.
幅 has the cloth (巾): how wide a piece of cloth is, width.
The place (場) you see on the surface (面): a scene in a story or film.
A pattern or limit (範) that surrounds (囲) it: the range or scope.
Commit (犯) a wrong (罪): a crime.
Turn back (反) and look at yourself (省): reflecting on what you did wrong.
Flat (平) and equal grade (等): everyone treated the same, equality.
防 means defend: to block something bad, like stopping a cold.
Not (不) to your benefit (利): a disadvantage.
Fog (雰) that surrounds (囲) you, plus air (気): the mood of a place.
Divided (分) fields (野): an area or field of study.
Flat (平) and level (均): the average, everything evened out.
Flat and calm (平) plus harmony (和): peace.
Plentiful (豊) and rich (富): lots of something.
Direction (方) repeated (々): in all directions, everywhere.
A walking (歩) path (道): the sidewalk for people on foot.
全 means whole: completely, totally. まったく! also means 'Honestly!' when annoyed.
Point (指) and wave (揮) your hand: a conductor directing an orchestra, command.
Decline (辞) and step back (退): politely refusing an offer.
The true (正) body (体): someone's real identity behind the mask.
継 has thread (糸): you tie on and continue the line, taking over the family business.
Turn (転) to a new school (校): changing schools.
Pass on (伝) words (言): a message you leave for someone.
Keep safe (保) and guard (護): protection, like protecting animals.
Holding (もって) it before (前): done beforehand, in advance.
咳 has the mouth (口): せき, the sound of a cough coming out.
稲 has the grain radical (禾): the rice plant in the paddy field.
蚊 has the insect radical (虫): か, the small buzzing mosquito.
岸 has the mountain (山) and a cliff (厂): the steep bank or shore.
旧 has the sun (日): many old days ago. 旧 means old or former, ex-.
Think of てき as 'tackle': the enemy who tackles you, your rival.
びん sounds like 'bin': throw the glass bottle in the bin.
幕 has the cloth (巾): the big curtain on a stage.
版 has the wood board (片): a printing block, so one edition of a book.
さる sounds like 'Sarah': Sarah the monkey swings from tree to tree.
州 shows islands in a river (川 with dots): land between rivers, a state.
銃 has the metal radical (金): a gun, a weapon made of metal.
Wind (風) on the mountain (山): a storm.
陰 has the hill (阝): the shady side of a hill, out of the sun.
籠 has bamboo (竹) on top: a basket or cage woven from bamboo.
鐘 has metal (金): the big metal bell at a temple. かね is also money, both metal.
革 is a stretched animal hide: leather, like 革の靴 (leather shoes).
癖 has the sickness radical (疒): a bad habit you cannot cure.
訓 has words (言): the native Japanese word used to read a kanji, kun reading.
綿 has thread (糸) and white (白): white cotton thread.
綿 has thread (糸) and white (白): soft white cotton wool, わた.
菌 has the grass radical (艹): tiny living things like mould, germs.
肌 has the flesh radical (月): your skin.
仏 is a person (亻): the Buddha, a person who became enlightened.
堀 has earth (土): dig the earth to make a moat around a castle.
脳 has the flesh radical (月): the brain inside your head.
班 shows a knife (刂) cutting jade (王) in two: split into small groups.
The way (法) of doing (作) things: good manners and etiquette.
様 means kind or manner, doubled (々): many kinds, various.
覚 means wake up and notice: you wake up from sleep.
去 means go away, like 過去 (the past, gone by): to leave.
Join in (参) and think (考): something you use for reference.
Sour (酸) nature (性): acidity, like lemon juice.
The sour (酸) element (素): oxygen (its old name means 'acid maker').
Jet (ジェット) plus machine (機): a jet plane.
Arriving at (至) hurry (急): extremely urgent, right now.
Kill (殺) oneself (自): suicide.
Payment (支) going out (出): expenses, money you spend.
沈 has water (氵): to sink under water, or to feel low.
親 means parent or close: as close as family, intimate.
Lose (失) your work (業): unemployment.
Damp (湿) air (気): humidity, moisture in the air.
Actually (実) carry out (施): putting a plan into action.
Damp (湿) degree (度): how humid it is, as a number.
Child (児) plus child (童): children, especially school kids.
Die (死) and be lost (亡): death, an official word.
Money (資) as the base (本): capital to start a business.
The taste (味) of earth (地): plain and modest, not flashy.
The main teaching (宗) you are taught (教): religion.
Fix (修) to make right (正): correcting a mistake.
Heavy (重) body (体): a body in serious condition, critically ill.
Sluggish (渋) and stuck (滞): a traffic jam. Same sound as 重体!
Gather (集) into a group (団): a mass of people.
Main (主) principle (義): an -ism, like 資本主義 (capitalism).
Lodge (宿) and stay the night (泊): hotel accommodation.
The head (首) city (都): the capital.
The main (主) woman (婦) of the home: housewife.
Main (主) and needed (要): chief, most important.
Things you need (需) and want (要): demand, as in supply and demand.
In order (順) and in tune (調): everything going smoothly.
A block (障) that does harm (害): an obstacle, or a disability.
Go up (上) to the capital (京): moving to Tokyo.
Exactly (正) the hour of the horse (午): 12 noon, as in 午前 and 午後.
A little (少) woman (女): a young girl.
Go up (上) and reach (達) a higher level: improving at a skill.
Upper (上) grade (等): first class, excellent quality.
Rush into (衝) and crash suddenly (突): a collision.
Leave out (省) and shorten (略): an abbreviation.
Woman (女) king (王): a queen. Note the reading じょおう.
Eating (食) things (物): food.
Food (食) and grain (糧): food supplies.
A writing (書) room (斎): your study at home.
徐 means slowly, doubled (々): little by little.
Sign (署) your name (名): a signature.
Written (書) things (物): books.
Know (知) each other (合い): an acquaintance.
Divine (神) pathways (経): nerves, the lines carrying signals in your body.
